behavior.description: A box that remains hidden and intangible until the nearest bhvFloorSwitchHiddenObjects enter the PURPLE_SWITCH_ACT_TICKING state. Depending on the type, it either executes hidden_breakable_box_actions or hidden_unbreakable_box_actions. Unbreakable variants disappear after 400 frames (360 wait + 40 blink).

enum.name: Unbreakable
enum.description: Forces the wdw hidden plataform collision.
